description: benchreceipt.policy/v1 — the .benchreceipt.toml policy, expressed as JSON Schema over its tomllib-parsed form (PROJECT_BOOK §6.3). Frozen by P027-T002. Missing required fields make a policy INVALID (PROJECT_BOOK §5.6 ban rule); the loader never invents a passing default. The only safe default is security.* = false (do not store stdout/stderr/environment).

expected_workflow.description: Workflow name or file that receipts must belong to.

min_tests.description: Minimum JUnit test count per job. Schema minimum is 0; the verify rule that tests must be > 0 (PROJECT_BOOK §5.4) is enforced by T008, not by this schema.

reports.description: Both junit and lcov must be declared explicitly; an undeclared report requirement is INVALID, never silently optional.

require_clean_source_after.description: If true, a dirty tracked worktree at capture end fails verification.

required_jobs.description: Non-empty: an empty required set would make the matrix check vacuous, so it is INVALID.

same_run_attempt.description: If true, all jobs must share one run_attempt.

same_run_id.description: If true, all jobs must share one workflow run id.

same_tree_across_jobs.description: If true, all jobs must share one tree SHA.

schema_version.description: Policy format version. Only 1 is valid for spec v1.0.0.

security.description: Optional section. Any missing field defaults to false (safe direction: do not store). A missing section is NOT an error.

store_full_environment.description: Must stay false in v1: full environments are never stored (PROJECT_BOOK §11.1).

store_stderr.description: Must stay false in v1: full stderr is never stored.

store_stdout.description: Must stay false in v1: full stdout is never stored.

source_mode.description: Which SHA the receipts are expected to match. merge_commit must be chosen explicitly; PR head and merge SHA are never treated as equivalent (PROJECT_BOOK §5.3).
